title: Final-answer verdict envelope (G37 D3)
description: The machine-readable block a behavioral scenario's final answer must end with, extracted into claim.json. Typed rather than parsed from prose: a regex over final.md can neither tell 'ABI-compatible but source-breaking' from hedging nor tell a correct caveat from an arbitrary confident:false.

verdict.description: compare's own ordinal vocabulary, or null for a pair the agent judges not comparable. Never a green/not-green boolean, which would erase the ABI-vs-source distinction the skills exist to make.

evidence.description: Call ids from calls.jsonl the claim rests on. Empty is legal only alongside confident:false — a definite verdict resting on nothing fails dimension 3.

uncertainty.description: Required when confident is false. Closed vocabulary so dimension 2 can grade the caveat against the artifact instead of reading prose.

unresolved.description: What specifically is unresolved — the target that never ran, the domain short of evidence, the depth the question needed.

matrix.description: Release-scope answers only. An unrun cell is a recorded fact rather than an omission: claim.verdict is one ordinal and cannot express 'compatible on the cells that ran, unknown overall'.

state.description: native-release-compatibility/SKILL.md's five per-cell states. not_run is unknown and blocks; it is never collapsible into pass.
